semantics: Documentation graphs, not executable n8n workflows. Edges are process/data-flow compositions supported by references; planned edges are proposals.
title: Checkout & address validation
subtitle: Indian address validation, shipping availability and authoritative pricing

nodes.label: Review bag and address
nodes.description: Checkout page collects customer address and shipping preferences.

nodes.label: Request shipping + quote
nodes.description: Quote input is strict; origin and rate-limit checks apply.

nodes.label: Validate Indian address
nodes.description: Country IN, six-digit PIN, email, city and region. Checkout input requires a valid Indian mobile number.

nodes.label: Delhivery serviceability
nodes.description: Checkout page separately calls shipping/serviceability for the PIN code. Runtime configuration and connectivity are Unverified.

nodes.label: Server checkout pricing
nodes.description: Price catalog lines, shipping and coupon rules using server records.

nodes.label: Cart / coupons / settings
nodes.description: Persisted cart version and current discount data are used to construct the quote.

nodes.label: Confirm authoritative total
nodes.description: Frontend displays quote and passes quoteId to secure checkout.

nodes.label: Request failed
nodes.description: Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.

nodes.label: Show error / retry
nodes.description: Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.

notes: Source implementation is documented; deployed configuration and provider connectivity are not verified.
Serviceability is a separate frontend request, not a sequential call inside checkoutQuote. The diagram expresses the checkout interaction, not a single handler stack.
